description: A special assets director must approve a restructuring of a commercial real-estate loan and finalize the extension, borrower contribution, collateral treatment, and monitoring package, with input from risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management.

shared_context.S1: The bank has an $8,000,000 term loan to Harbor Point Properties, secured by the borrower's office building, equipment, and receivables.
shared_context.S2: Harbor Point has requested a restructuring after weaker-than-expected occupancy reduced its scheduled debt-service coverage.
shared_context.S3: The borrower's proposal requests a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding restructuring decision. The standard workout meeting agenda calls for risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management to review the proposal before Elena records the final terms.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena records the final terms, each reviewer gives a brief findings update and identifies the supporting document or policy for any recommendation. For any covenant-testing finding, Jonas must use the meeting's formal finding-reveal step before Elena can record a settlement, and Elena includes the relevant sources in the meeting minutes.
shared_context.S6: The applicable workout treatment depends on the current covenant test and the supporting policy materials, so the proposal cannot be finalized from the borrower's requested terms alone.

PF1.text: Jonas found in the covenant testing file this week that leverage is 0.3x above the permitted level; workout policy allows a waiver only with a 9-month, not 12-month, extension and a monthly leverage certificate, and he has not yet attached the testing file to the committee package.

PF2.text: Mei received a signed term sheet from Harbor Point this morning committing the owners to inject exactly $1,200,000 of new equity at restructuring closing; the commitment has not yet been entered in the relationship system.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed while reviewing the intercreditor agreement this week that the senior lender must give written consent before any equipment collateral is released; that consent has not yet been requested.

PF4.text: Nadia completed a collateral review yesterday showing that receivables are the weakest and most volatile part of the package; collateral policy therefore requires a weekly borrowing-base certificate throughout the extension, and she has not yet updated the monitoring schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The restructuring must be approved with a 9-month maturity extension.
The approval must require exactly $1,200,000 of new borrower equity at closing.
A monthly leverage certificate must be required.
No equipment collateral may be released unless the restructuring terms preserve the existing equipment lien.
Receivables must be monitored through a weekly borrowing-base certificate.
The settlement should record the equity injection, preserve the equipment lien, and include weekly borrowing-base reporting among its implementation commitments.

content_checks.C7: decisions['borrower_equity_injection_usd'] == 1200000 and any(c['type'] in ['equity_injection', 'condition_precedent', 'system_entry', 'system_update', 'follow-up', 'action_item', 'document_attachment'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: decisions['equipment_collateral_release_usd'] == 0 and any(c['target'] == 'Rafael' and c['type'] in ['equipment_lien_preservation', 'consent_request', 'third_party_consent', 'external_action', 'legal_action_required', 'legal_action', 'action_required', 'follow-up', 'consent_obtained', 'document_reference', 'condition_precedent', 'action_item', 'document_attachment', 'contingency', 'system_update'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: (decisions['receivables_monitoring_frequency'] == 'weekly' or decisions['receivables_monitoring_frequency'] == 'weekly borrowing-base certificate') and any(c['target'] == 'Nadia' and c['type'] in ['weekly_borrowing_base_reporting', 'schedule_update', 'monitoring_update', 'monitoring_requirement', 'reporting_requirement', 'follow-up', 'action_item', 'document_attachment', 'system_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The shared proposal requests 12 months without specifying testing conditions; PF1 changes the permitted extension to exactly 9 months, adds the monthly leverage certificate, and supplies the required cited basis.

Without PF2, the bank has no confirmed new capital supporting an executable approval; PF2 changes the required borrower contribution to exactly $1,200,000 and requires an equity-related implementation commitment.

The shared proposal requests release of $900,000 of equipment collateral; PF3 changes the settlement to zero equipment release and requires a commitment preserving the lien or requiring senior-lender consent.
The shared proposal has no receivables monitoring cadence; PF4 changes the required cadence to weekly borrowing-base certificates and requires a monitoring-schedule commitment.
